3d6eae5d0cf6: A gateway language is the language your team reads the source and helps in. English comes with the app.
7d17ef831dae: Under Choose your gateway language, click a language (1). If "Turn on the internet?" appears, click Turn on internet. See Working offline.
619a3f60dc35: Check the Package contents. Click a card to leave it out, or again to add it back.
b2d5c7505186: Click ⇣ Download package. When it says "✓ {book} · {language} is ready", click Close.
8b9d01dac0a2: While the package downloads, the bottom of the dialog shows Downloading … with the repository it is fetching, and a Cancel button. They stay there if you choose another book or go back to the list of languages. Click Cancel to stop the download.
8b8f02c8633e: To leave without downloading, click Close or the ✕. Closing the dialog doesn't stop a download that has started; open Get source texts again to see it or cancel it.
2fc42d3c75b4: For most gateway languages the package includes a Translation Words Links repository (…_twl) as well as Translation Words. Leave it selected so checking can finish installing.
acf775b53543: Two rows can share a name, like the two Français rows. The organisation under the name tells them apart.
1c359191fab9: The versions in the list are the newest on Door43, not the ones your project uses.
84b941e238b1: To check in the downloaded language, choose it in Project settings. See Change the checking language.
ab9ab2d35728: Offline, the dialog says "tC4 did not read the Door43 list of source texts." with Read the list. The line under it, "This organisation publishes nothing tC4 can use…", only means the list hasn't been read.
2827fe51be40: If some downloads fail, the dialog lists them.
7dd6ae7b823d: Get source texts. Pinned resources with Check for updates, then Choose your gateway language: English (unfoldingWord, notes v91, words v91, academy v91), Español (Latinoamérica) (es-419_gl, marked 1), two rows named Français (Xenizo and MVHS), and Русский.
